cuda_oom.message: GPU ran out of memory loading the model. Use fewer/larger GPUs, lower gpu_memory_utilization, or reduce max_model_len.

decrease_maxlen_phrasing.message: KV cache too small for the requested context. Lower max_model_len or raise gpu_memory_utilization for the selected GPU(s).

kv_overflow_no_estimate.message: KV cache too small for the requested context. Lower max_model_len or raise gpu_memory_utilization for the selected GPU(s).

kv_overflow_with_estimate.message: Context too long for GPU memory: model wants 262144 tokens (needs 16.0 GiB KV cache) but only 9.6 GiB is available. vLLM estimates the max workable context here is 157216 — set max_model_len <= 157216, or raise gpu_memory_utilization.

no_cache_blocks.message: GPU has no room for the KV cache after loading the weights — the model is too large for the selected GPU(s) at this gpu_memory_utilization. Use more/larger GPUs or raise gpu_memory_utilization.

trust_remote_code_genuinely_required.message: This model requires trust_remote_code to load. Enable trust_remote_code for this model (it executes code from the model repo — only do this for repos you trust), then retry.
